sources.title: PlagueKind MiniMax H3 - a Hugging Face Space by mcuo
sources.snippet: MiniMax-H3 is a 33B parameter video generation model that produces video and a fully synchronized soundtrack (ambience, foley, speech) in one pass. PlagueKind's V1.5 workflow is a tuning of it: euler on a linear_quadratic sigma grid at 15 steps, FSR RCAS sharpening at 0.3, and FILM 2x frame interpolation to 48 fps. Text-to-video, first frame, last frame, or both.
